items.html: It thus follows that during the time of nursing, ZA suckled from these breasts, which is the upper Shaddai with the rafa, from the HGT of Ima, and the three middle ones of ZA grew, and in him were made the secret of 72, 216, 26, as mentioned. And afterward, also the NHY of ZA suckled from these upper breasts, and in them were made other, lower 72, 216, 26, in the NHY within him, in the secret of the Name Shaddai with the dagesh, which is more judgment.
